title: [Main]-Prepayment amounts are incorrectly recalculated in statistics after partial posting when Prepmt. Amt. to Deduct Excl. VAT is manually adjusted
summary: Fixed the Sales Line prepayment recalculation so Prepmt. Line Amount no longer grows past the invoiced prepayment after a partial posting where Prepmt Amt to Deduct was raised manually. Statistics now show stable values, and the remaining quantity can be posted.
key_points: Added local procedure CapPrepmtLineAmountAfterOverDeduction, called in UpdatePrepmtAmounts after the Prepmt. Line Amount recalculation
When an amount was deducted and the recalculated value exceeds both Prepmt. Amt. Inv. and the line's total prepayment, it is capped at the larger of the two
Fixes the false 'prepayment invoices not posted' error when posting the remaining quantity
Recalculation was triggered on closing Statistics via ReleaseSalesDocument.CalcAndUpdateVATOnLines and UpdateVATOnLines
Applied in W1 and 11 localization layers, with regression tests in W1 and RU
quote: Prepayment amounts are incorrectly recalculated in statistics after partial posting when Prepmt. Amt. to Deduct Excl. VAT is manually adjusted.
